propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the shared 'rebar' logger globally, preventing caplog from capturing subsequent rebar.* logger records within the same process

test_success_telemetry_survives_an_empty_usage_dict fails intermittently when other tests call configure_logging() earlier in the run order, but passes in isolation due to process-global logger state mutation
removing propagate=False mutation preserves existing double-logging prevention (via marker-guarded handler and uvicorn's own lack of root handler mutations) while restoring caplog functionality

caplog assertions on rebar.* loggers silently produce empty record sets after configure_logging() runs, causing silent failures in positive assertions (StopIteration, AssertionError) and vacuous passes in negative assertions
